description: Container-level security context of a valkey container.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Whether the process can gain more privileges than its parent process.

localhostProfile.description: Name of the profile loaded on the node, with the `Localhost` type.

add.description: Linux capabilities added to the container (for example `NET_ADMIN`).

drop.description: Linux capabilities dropped from the container (for example `ALL`).

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities added to or dropped from the container.

privileged.description: Whether the container runs in privileged mode.

procMount.description: Type of the proc mount of the container.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Whether the root filesystem of the container is read-only.

runAsGroup.description: Group ID of the first process of the container.

runAsNonRoot.description: Whether the container must run as a non-root user.

runAsUser.description: User ID of the first process of the container.

localhostProfile.description: Path of the profile on the node, relative to the kubelet seccomp directory, with the `Localhost` type.

gmsaCredentialSpec.description: Contents of the GMSA credential spec, Windows only.

gmsaCredentialSpecName.description: Name of the GMSA credential spec, Windows only.

hostProcess.description: Whether the container runs as a HostProcess container, Windows only.

runAsUserName.description: User name the first process of the container runs as, Windows only.

windowsOptions.description: Windows specific options of the container.
